Strategy gets you noticed. Story gets you remembered.

I'm Favour. For five years I've helped brands figure out what they stand for, then show it to the world one scroll at a time.

Publishing. Real estate. Fashion. Skincare. Four industries, four different audiences, and the same question every time: why should anyone stop and care?

I answer it with a message that's clear, a plan that holds together and video people actually finish. I can write the strategy, script the idea, build the visuals with AI and cut the final edit myself.

Then I watch what people watch, share and skip, and I make the next piece better.

My degree is in Linguistics and Language Arts from the University of Port Harcourt, so words are where I always start.

What I can build
for your brand

Hire me for one thing or let me run the whole chain. It all fits together.

  • Brand Strategy & Positioning

    Before you post anything, I work out what you want to be known for and how to say it so people get it in one glance.

  • Content Strategy & Direction

    A plan with a point of view. Calendars, messaging and creative direction that make every post earn its place.

  • Social Media Marketing

    I run your channels like they matter, because they do. Content that fits each platform and an audience that sticks around.

  • AI Video Creation

    UGC style ads, promos and story videos made with AI, from script to final cut, at a pace your content calendar can keep up with.

  • AI Storytelling & Creative Production

    Give me a script or a rough idea and I'll turn it into a visual story with AI images, AI video and careful editing.

  • Brand Content Creation

    Flyers, campaign visuals and promotional material that look like they came from the same brand, because they did.

  • Audience Engagement & Community Management

    Followers become a community when someone actually answers. I keep the conversation warm and the relationships real.
